name: The Memory Journal
source:
Four people; an idol, a fortune teller, a gardener and a janitor. Magic and mystery shrouds them, and in their hands lays your life. Accompany them on a quest to find remembrance, while you tip the scales between monster and man; foe and friend. In this psychological horror extravaganza, you stand to slay Gods, influence the make-up of the universe and, on the way, participate in a spot of petty theft or a cup of tea if time permits.

You will do whatever it takes to achieve remembrance, for without it you are dead.

So there lies the options at your disposal: a fleeting enigma that provides no truths; a specter whose shoulders harbor a deathly weight; a doll with rolled back eyes; a prince taken by wolves. Be warned… What you make of them will be acknowledged, as your puppeted actions contribute to all timelines.

Now embark, remnant, and challenge all those that dare sully your path!

“’Challenge’? Doll, what’s with all this ambition? Aha, I’m sorry for reading your journal, but for being in your thoughts, well… I would hope to have a clearer picture of all your dramatics. You needn’t say one word more, honey, for I know your true intentions now. The time for words is over…

“…because you should have told me you wanted tea! I’ll have it brewing in a jiffy~”

[from [url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/the-memory-journal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四人；偶像、算命先生、园丁和看门人。魔法和神秘笼罩着他们，你的生命掌握在他们手中。陪伴他们寻找记忆，同时在怪物和人类之间倾斜；敌人和朋友。在这场心理恐怖盛宴中，你将杀死众神，影响宇宙的构成，并在途中参与小偷小摸或在时间允许的情况下喝杯茶。

你会尽一切努力来获得记忆，因为没有它你就死了。

因此，你可以选择：一个转瞬即逝的谜团，无法提供真相；肩膀上承受着致命重量的幽灵；一个翻白眼的洋娃娃；被狼抓走的王子。请注意……你对它们所做的一切将被承认，因为你的傀儡行为对所有时间线都有贡献。

现在出发，留下来，挑战所有胆敢玷污你道路的人！

“‘挑战’？娃娃，这一切是怎么回事？啊哈，我很抱歉读了你的日记，但我在你的想法中，嗯……我希望能更清楚地了解你所有的戏剧性事件。你不必再多说一个字，亲爱的，因为我现在知道你的真实意图了。言语的时间结束了……

“……因为你应该告诉我你想要茶！我一会儿就泡好了~””

[来自[url=https://specter-of-you.itch.io/the-memory-journal]Itch.io[/url]]
